page: Microsoft Azure E64s_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the Esv6 server family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 32 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8573C processor operating at a clock speed of 4.2 GHz. The processor includes a 260 MB L3 cache, 2 MB L2 cache, and 48 KB L1d cache. The system is equipped with 512.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. This instance does not include local storage or bundled GPUs, but it is Premium Storage capable.

Benchmark data indicates strong multi-core and memory performance. The server achieved a top-tier rating in Geekbench multi-core testing with a score of 20795.0, alongside strong single-core performance. Memory bandwidth is highly efficient, reaching top-tier speeds of 430.32 GB/sec for large-block read-only operations and 185.29 GB/sec for large-block write operations. In database operations, the instance demonstrated top-tier performance in Passmark database tests and strong throughput in Redis SET operations, processing 89.49 million operations per second.

The Intel Xeon processor supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), which accelerate cryptographic, vector, and matrix operations. This is reflected in strong LLM inference speeds, particularly for prompt processing across small, medium, and large models. Given the high memory density, strong multi-threaded decompression capabilities, and top-tier database performance, the E64s_v6 is suited for memory-intensive workloads, enterprise database systems, large-scale data processing, and memory-bound analytical applications.
description: Microsoft Azure E64s_v6 is an x86_64 memory-optimized server instance from the Esv6 family, powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8573C processor. It features 64 vCPUs (32 physical cores) running at 4.2 GHz, supported by a 260 MB L3 cache and 512.0 GB of RAM, yielding a high 8.0 GB per core memory density. While it lacks local storage and bundled GPUs, it is Premium Storage capable. Benchmarks reveal top-tier performance in large-block memory bandwidth (430.32 GB/sec read) and Passmark database operations, alongside strong multi-core processing capabilities. The processor's support for AVX-512 and Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) enhances cryptographic and vector calculations. This hardware profile makes the E64s_v6 highly suitable for memory-intensive enterprise databases, large-scale data processing, and analytical workloads requiring substantial memory capacity and high memory bandwidth.
